It would probably be a good idea to mark which of these are not backwards compatible. In particular, merging CMENE into GOhA is unacceptably (to me) incompatable, because it completely changes the parse of bridi like {la .xorxes. cusku} (which becomes a sumti, (a {.xorxes. cusku} tanru), instead of a full bridi).
